ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar May-02-2006 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of an Adult an of a Minor.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Laura Martinez.
Petitioner: Sandra Sanchez, present in pro per for self and as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Shimei Ethan Shortridge, II, was sworn and examined.
Request for DISPENSING NOTICE granted and signed in open court.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: Saundrah Anjali Sanchez and grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Ethan Izaiyah Sanchez.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Apr-12-2006 Reset To May-02-06 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of an Adult and a minor.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: E. Bura/S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Laura Martinez.
Petitioner: Sandra Sanchez, present in pro per as Guardian Ad Litem for Shimei Ethan Shortridge II, was sworn and examined.
Matter was continued to May 2, 2006, for petitioner to file an application and declaration dispensing notice to minor's father.
